Bullet Physics 3.25 (zlib license, see LICENSE.txt), from
https://github.com/bulletphysics/bullet3/archive/refs/tags/3.25.tar.gz
(sha256 c45afb6399e3f68036ddb641c6bf6f552bf332d5ab6be62f7e6c54eda05ceb77).

Only `src/LinearMath`, `src/BulletCollision` and `src/BulletDynamics` are kept, without
`Gimpact`, `Featherstone`, `MLCPSolvers`, `Character`, `btCollisionWorldImporter` and the build
files. The sources are unmodified and compiled by the package's CMake and podspec.
